questions.title: Familiarisation Question 4
questions.stimulus:
This structure chart describes a hotel booking system.

![](assets/fam_Q4s-1.png)

parts.prompt: Select the items that are TRUE about this structure chart. (Multiple items may be selected.)

options.text: **Booking ID** may only be true or false.
**Display new bookings** may not be executed.
Members do not need to log in to browse hotels.
A choice is continually offered between **Browse hotels** and **Book**.
**Login** calls **Enter member details and validate** when Member ID is set to true.

marking_criteria.criterion: Selects all TRUE statements and no FALSE statements
Selects at least two TRUE statements with at most one error

parts.sample_answer:
TRUE: Booking made is a flag (filled circle = control parameter); Login is called first (modules execute left to right); Display new bookings may not be executed (diamond = selection); a choice is continually offered between Browse hotels and Book (diamond inside the "Until done" loop).
FALSE: Booking ID is a data parameter (open circle), not a flag; Login is always called before Browse hotels, so members must log in; Login repeats Enter member details and validate until Valid is true — Member ID is data, not a Boolean.

parts.prompt: This structure chart describes an online ordering system for a café. Which of the following statements are TRUE about this structure chart? (More than one may be selected.)

options.text: Order number is a control variable
A valid loyalty account is not required for online ordering
The order cannot be displayed until the cart is confirmed
A choice is repeatedly offered between **Browse menu** and **Add items to order**

marking_criteria.criterion: Correctly identifies all the items that are true about the structure chart
Identifies true or false correctly for THREE out of five checkboxes
